releaseGate.reason: No new prospective independent evaluation; no lineup data integrated; official V1.0 unchanged.

selection.criterion: lowest 1X2 log loss on chronological development predictions

protocol.cutoff: Strictly earlier calendar dates only; group/league stages only; exact same input rows and dates for both models.
protocol.refit: Joint model refitted independently once per match calendar date; no target-day match can train another target-day prediction.
protocol.estimation: Joint weighted regularized Poisson maximum likelihood; cyclic coordinate Newton with backtracking.
protocol.selection: Only ridge is selected on 2023/24; no tuning on 2024/25 or 2025/26.
protocol.validation: 2024/25 and 2025/26 scores were already examined in V1.0. These are development comparisons, NOT independent holdout results.
protocol.lineup: No player, injury, lineup, domestic league or tactical numerical effects.

finalFit.estimation: Joint weighted regularized Poisson maximum likelihood; cyclic coordinate Newton with backtracking.

caveats: Historical scores were downloaded after matches; original publication timestamps are unavailable.
Chronological reconstruction is not a historical saved live-prediction record.
The source set ends before the 2026/27 season: no current-season results or lineup observations are included.
Unknown teams shrink to zero attack/defense effects; this is not proof they have average real-world ability.
Independent Poisson does not model low-score dependence, injuries or tactical interactions.
Metrics are aggregate comparisons without uncertainty intervals and do not guarantee future improvement.
Brier score measures more than calibration; inspect reliability bins alongside proper scoring rules.
